page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note at the right, beside the first lines of the paragraph beginning "PROXIMO". Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: qui denuo restitutis ijs quae per pontificios obliterarentur, alias deinceps picturas non parum plures artec celebriores adiecerunt, adeoque numero, potentiaque prevaluisse pictores istos, ut iam omnes cardinalitiae centuriae cum pontifice ipso, ijs rursus delendis impares extitissent. Hoc enigmate usum est Deo, quid esset secuturum servo suo, pateface-re nec ipse fefellit exitus, quamquam nos sonnij prophetici sententiam aliorum coniecturis aestimandum relinquimus.
main_text.head: HISTORIA HIERONYMI PRAGENSIS ex Poggio, aliisque deprompta.

page.notes: The marginal note "An. 1416." is printed at the right beside the paragraph. The heading's second line is set in italic. Some letters in the scan are damaged, notably in "Hieronymus"/"Pragensis" and in the first line of the page; readings are best effort.
